name: Embodied AI AIR
summary: A Swiss wheeled robot with a torso, a head and two light tendon-driven arms, made to work next to factory staff without a cage. A remote operator runs it until it has learned the task.

germany.statusNote: Unveiled on 6 November 2026 at Humanoid Europe in Munich. The company says orders open after the show, but no price or delivery date exists, and CE marking is only planned for 2027. Without the mark it cannot be sold as a finished machine in the EU.

specs.label: Safety design
specs.value: Designed under ISO/TS 15066:2016; CE marking planned for 2027

notes: Height, weight, reach, battery life and full payload are unpublished. The only arm figure comes from an investor: a 2 kg tendon-driven arm that lifts 5 kg.
Runs on wheels because factory floors are flat, according to the company.
The company has not said which end effector it uses.

images.alt: Embodied AI AIR, a blue robot torso with two arms on a wheeled base

evidence.task: Company says AIR is being tested with global manufacturers
evidence.note: Customers unnamed. Reported pilot results come from an earlier two-armed robot cell, not from AIR.

sources.title: Swiss startup Embodied AI unveils AIR

openQuestions: Will orders from Germany be accepted before the CE mark?
